steps.title: Egg
steps.description: A female lays single eggs on the underside of milkweed leaves; each hatches after a few days.
steps.source: US Forest Service, Monarch butterfly life cycle

steps.title: Caterpillar (larva)
steps.description: The caterpillar eats milkweed almost nonstop, molting its skin several times as it grows over about two weeks.
steps.source: US Forest Service, Monarch butterfly life cycle

steps.title: Chrysalis (pupa)
steps.description: It hangs upside down and forms a green chrysalis, inside which its body is broken down and rebuilt.
steps.source: US Forest Service, Monarch butterfly life cycle

steps.title: Adult butterfly
steps.description: The butterfly emerges, dries its wings, feeds on nectar, mates and lays eggs; the late-summer generation migrates south.
steps.source: US Forest Service, Monarch butterfly life cycle
